translated_title: Mexico's Lack of Private Investment: Taking On the Challenge in Post-Neoliberal Times
original_title: Falta de inversión privada en México: asumir el reto en tiempos posneoliberales
author: Josafat Hernández
meta_description: Mexico draws record foreign investment while its national private sector lags—leaning on state infrastructure and incentives without matching it in productive investment or innovation.
